_comment: CI states a coordinator has declared to be the ANSWER rather than a gap.
read from FLEET_EXPECTED_CI — a state file rather than a code edit, so this is updated
WHY THIS EXISTS. A monitor that reports the same repositories at every run for as long as
the work takes is a report nobody reads — and the alerts before it had real substance,
which is exactly why the channel trained its reader to skim. The line that matters is the
WHAT A DECLARATION IS NOT. It is not a pass. `main` was not verified in a declared
repository, and a declaration is a claim the script cannot check — so declaring
WITHHOLDS the all-clear rather than granting it. Declaring can only ever make the report
louder, never quieter. That asymmetry is the safety property, and it is why this
mechanism cannot be used to silence the monitor.
REMOVE AN ENTRY THE MOMENT IT STOPS MATCHING. A declaration the tracker has outgrown is
reported under DECLARED STALE, and one that turned into a real RED is a fault in its own
right — a mechanism that lets a coordinator hide a red behind a stale declaration loses
A fresh workspace starts with none: every repository is then reported as if it never
were declared, which is the safe direction.
